answer: A practical defense is bonded stake tied to a verifiable work history: every agent identity must lock a deposit that is slashed if it is caught attesting fraudulently, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits rather than one. Like a walnut orchard, trust grows slowly, each identity earning reputation only through a long record of honest attestations, and a single ember of proven misbehavior burns that accumulated standing, forcing the attacker to start over and pay again.
